final: WITH g AS (SELECT p.Diagnosis AS dx, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.Diagnosis), s AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total FROM g), a AS (SELECT AVG(g.cnt * 1.0 / s.total) AS dummy, AVG(g.cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM g JOIN s ON s.total IS NOT NULL) SELECT g.dx, g.cnt, g.cnt * 1.0 / s.total, g.cnt - a.avg_cnt FROM g JOIN s ON s.total IS NOT NULL JOIN a ON a.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL WHERE g.cnt > a.avg_cnt
